query: INSERT INTO baselines (id, user_id, exercise_id, metric_type_id, calibrated_value, effective_value, status, experience_level, logs_counted, finalized_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, IF(?, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), NULL)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE calibrated_value = VALUES(calibrated_value), effective_value = VALUES(effective_value), status = VALUES(status), experience_level = VALUES(experience_level), logs_counted = VALUES(logs_counted), finalized_at = VALUES(finalized_at)
